title: Happy koala
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='30' r='15' fill='#9FB4C7'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='30' r='15' fill='#9FB4C7'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='30' r='9' fill='#D6E2EC'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='30' r='9' fill='#D6E2EC'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='46' r='26' fill='#B8CAD9'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='19' ry='16' fill='#DCE6EF'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='43' r='4.5' fill='#2E3A4A'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='43' r='4.5' fill='#2E3A4A'/>
  <circle cx='41.5' cy='41.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='41.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='53' rx='7' ry='9' fill='#3B4A5C'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50.5' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#6E8299'/>
  <!-- happy mouth -->
  <path d='M42 60 Q50 68 58 60' stroke='#5A6E82' stroke-width='2.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='56' r='4' fill='#F2A9B8' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='56' r='4' fill='#F2A9B8' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='21' ry='16' fill='#A9BECE'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#DCE6EF'/>
  <!-- little paws -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='83' r='5' fill='#C6D6E3'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='83' r='5' fill='#C6D6E3'/>
  <!-- tiny leaf -->
  <path d='M72 76 Q82 68 84 78 Q76 84 72 76 Z' fill='#7FD97F'/>
  <path d='M74 77 L82 77' stroke='#4FAF55' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
